assumptions: Ambiguity codes are counted as DnaChisel counts them.
limits: A window profile depends on the window size, which the answer states.
bio.jane/contract.noReading: The answer is the GC fraction (and its window profile), which the outputs carry; the editor shows it as a readout and writes no reading over it.
bio.jane/contract.question: What is this sequence's GC fraction, overall or along a sliding window?

description: GC fraction of the subject — whole-sequence, or a sliding window profile (DnaChisel).

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

window.description: sliding-window size; unset = one value for the whole sequence. In bp.

name: gc_content

gc.description: GC fraction over the whole sequence (0–1)

plot.description: the windowed GC profile as a plot, by window centre (only when `window` is set)

profile.description: per-window GC fractions (only when `window` is set)
